purpose.summary: A lightweight Spring Boot HTTP service that evaluates a JSON-defined rule grammar (all/any/not groups and field/op/value conditions) against an arbitrary JSON input payload and returns a boolean result.

components.name: REST API layer
components.purpose: Exposes the rule-evaluation capability over HTTP and maps domain errors to HTTP responses.

components.name: Rule evaluation engine
components.purpose: Parses and recursively evaluates the JSON rule grammar (groups and conditions) against input data.

components.name: Spring Boot bootstrap
components.purpose: Starts the embedded server and wires Spring component scanning/DI.

components.name: IDE scratch class
components.purpose: Leftover IntelliJ scaffold class not part of the application runtime.

entrypoints.name: POST /api/v1/rule-engine/evaluate
entrypoints.invocation: HTTP POST with JSON body {data, rule}

entrypoints.name: Main.main
entrypoints.invocation: java org.example.Main (not wired to Spring Boot app; not used by tests or build)

standard_commands.purpose: Build the application jar without running tests.
Run the application locally on port 8080.
